messages:
elaine: Scheduling a catalog enable for model 'redwood-cascade-v2' — change window 2025-04-02 15:00-17:00 UTC. Plan: staged traffic 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% (20m between steps). Fallback ordering set, pin list updated for EU. Details: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/CI-6284 :calendar:

mike: thanks. looping ops. any DB migrations or schema work?

lina: nope, no migrations. only routing table + variant mappings will change.

ops-oncall: I'll monitor latency and SLOs. Request: temporary autoscale bump +30% for first 40m. Set alerts: p95 > 200ms OR error_rate > 1% triggers rollback hook.

samira: added autoscale +30% to the rollout config and wired the alert -> rollback webhook.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: change window CI-6284 recorded, scheduled rollout script for 2025-04-02T15:00:00Z. Use /deploy run CI-6284 to start early.

product-alex: approved from PM. QA sign-off scheduled at 14:30 UTC (they'll post results here).

mike: one ask: prefer to avoid switching to quantized variants purely on latency spikes. If possible, only fall back to quant when errors increase.

elaine: good call — updated fallback ordering to prefer compatibility variants first, quantized as last resort. Pushing config now. snippet:

```
rollout:
  steps: [5, 25, 50, 100]
  step_interval_min: 20
fallback_order:
  - redwood-cascade-v2
  - redwood-cascade-v2-compat
  - legacy-flan-quant
alerts:
  p95_latency_ms: 200
  error_rate_pct: 1.0
autoscale: +30%
```

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: I'll open an incident channel if thresholds breach and will escalate.

samira: I'll run a dry run at 14:45 UTC to validate routes and metrics.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: reminder — 10 minutes until scheduled start for CI-6284.

elaine: copy. rollback command for quick pin if needed: `rwctl catalog pin legacy-flan@v3 --force --reason 'rollback'`

lina: noted — I'll also watch reranking and embedding stability during the rollout.

ops-oncall: standing by in #incidents and will post short summary after first two steps.
